# Stroma

> Stroma is a Community Medicine app for MBBS students and residents. It is the short-notes layer for the syllabus colleges teach from K. Park's Textbook of Preventive and Social Medicine. It does not distribute that textbook.

Stroma is published by Bottlegram Health (Anshuman Sinha). The public site is https://bottlegramhealth.in/. The iPhone and iPad app is free to download on the India App Store, with Pro as an in-app purchase.

## Notes

- [Concept of health and disease](https://bottlegramhealth.in/notes/concept-of-health-and-disease/): definitions, triad, iceberg, levels of prevention
- [Pearl index](https://bottlegramhealth.in/notes/pearl-index/): formula and a worked example
- [Screening calculations](https://bottlegramhealth.in/notes/screening-sensitivity-specificity/): sensitivity, specificity, PPV, NPV
- [Park, Marrow, review books, and Stroma](https://bottlegramhealth.in/notes/community-medicine-apps-mbbs-md/): MBBS and MD comparison
- [Park textbook notes for MBBS](https://bottlegramhealth.in/notes/park-textbook-alternative/): what Park is for, what short notes are for, and what Stroma includes
- [How to study Community Medicine](https://bottlegramhealth.in/notes/how-to-study-community-medicine/): revision order before a prof
- [PSM topics for MBBS exams](https://bottlegramhealth.in/notes/psm-topics-for-mbbs-exams/): the topic map, without copied tables or doses
- [Pricing](https://bottlegramhealth.in/pricing.md): India App Store prices checked 8 October 2026
